sloka: विध्वंसयन्तं तरसा दृष्ट्वैव पवनात्मजम्।राक्षसानां सहस्राणि हनुमन्तमवाकिरन् ।। ६.८६.२० ।।
transliteration: vidhvaṁsayantaṁ tarasā dṛṣṭvaiva pavanātmajam।rākṣasānāṁ sahasrāṇi hanumantamavākiran ।। 6.86.20 ।।

translations.english: Seeing the wind god's son destroying, thousands of Rakshasas got together surrounding him.
